source: Nuxt provides a private {0} as the application's root secret. Modules and server features derive their own secrets from it with {1}, and the {2}session helpers{/2} seal with one by default. The value defaults to an empty string, is only available on the server, and you can set it with {3} without declaring the key in {4}.
